sdk_selection_evidence.selection: Launcher takes the first drone with a non-None submission in map drone order; it does not score all simultaneous submissions and pick the best.
sdk_selection_evidence.termination: GUI runs all drivable drone controls for the frame, then terminates if any submitted. Multiple submissions in the same step are possible.

limitations: Only two new candidate rounds, one per requested map. Three comparator versions reuse source-verified same-seed historical runs.
Red-side subtotal out of 80 only; blue-side 20 untested.
Wall-clock and wall-budget-dependent control vary with runtime load. Earlier wall-limited submission steps do not prove computing speedup.
Ordinary slot mutual exclusion intentionally does not restrict hard deadline fallbacks.
Official offline scoring uses saved images after the match, never controller-accessible truth.
One seed does not establish stable score improvement across maps/seeds.
